records.text: GitHub Actions CI workflows validate Python packages, run unit tests, and block release when required checks fail.
A CI pipeline uses least-privilege GitHub token permissions and read-only repository access unless a reviewed job needs more.
Contract validation checks JSON schemas, policy invariants, and deterministic output before a continuous integration job succeeds.
Integration tests use synthetic fixtures and local services to verify application boundaries without production credentials.
Build artifact provenance records the source commit, workflow run, package identity, and SHA-256 digest for later verification.
A reviewed release moves a validated artifact through staging with human approval and a documented rollback plan.
Flaky test triage separates intermittent runner failures from deterministic regressions and retains the original failing evidence.
A container image should be referenced by immutable digest so a deployment uses the exact scanned build artifact.
A hardened Dockerfile runs the application as a non-root user and keeps writable filesystem paths narrowly scoped.
Container layer caching speeds local builds, while cache keys must include dependency lockfile changes.
A container health check reports process readiness and does not expose secret values or internal environment details.
An image vulnerability scan records the base image digest and fails on the repository-defined severity threshold.
Kubernetes readiness probes remove a pod from service until the application can safely receive requests.
Kubernetes namespaces organize workloads but do not replace network policy, identity controls, or tenant authorization.
Kubernetes CPU and memory requests and limits bound workload scheduling and container resource consumption.
A Kubernetes network policy restricts pod ingress and egress to explicitly approved application paths.
A deployment rollout changes replicas gradually and reports progress before an operator approves production release.
Prometheus scrapes bounded application metrics and labels without customer text or high-cardinality identifiers.
Alert routing sends actionable service health signals to an owned response path with severity and runbook context.
OpenTelemetry trace context links spans across local services while sensitive request bodies remain excluded.
Structured logs use stable event fields and correlation identifiers but never include credentials or raw document contents.
A service level objective tracks request latency percentiles over a declared window and separates measurements from targets.
An observability dashboard displays the observation timestamp and labels stale data instead of implying real-time status.
A knowledge source manifest links a synthetic source policy, document version, SHA-256 hash, and provenance reference.
Document version integrity compares exact UTF-8 bytes with a SHA-256 digest; the digest does not prove source authenticity.
Knowledge chunks use half-open UTF-8 byte offsets and must not split a multibyte code point.
A retention policy defines expiry and deletion handling, while an in-memory prototype cannot prove durable erasure.
A retrieval citation identifies the source, document, version, chunk hash, byte span, and provenance reference.
BM25 lexical retrieval ranks matching chunks by term frequency, inverse document frequency, and normalized chunk length.
Agent coordination assigns each task an owner, bounded objective, dependency, and verification evidence.
Parallel agents use isolated branches and non-overlapping file ownership to prevent conflicting repository changes.
A human approval queue keeps production changes pending until an authorized reviewer approves the exact commit and scope.
Retrieved prompt injection is untrusted data and cannot grant tool permissions, override system policy, or authorize actions.
A worker timeout and process budget bound automated task execution and return a fixed failure without partial success.
An agent audit record links a proposal to its source evidence, policy version, approval state, and immutable commit reference.

يحتاج تنسيق الوكلاء إلى مالك واضح للمهمة وموافقة بشرية قبل أي تغيير إنتاجي.
تتحقق GitHub Actions من CI وتفرض صلاحيات قليلة وتوثق SHA لكل نتيجة اختبار.
تراقب Kubernetes readiness probe جاهزية الخدمة قبل توجيه الطلبات إلى الحاوية.
تعرض Prometheus مؤشرات latency ونتائج alert دون تخزين محتوى المستخدم.
Git history stores commits and branches; a diagram of repository labels does not measure test execution.
An invoice lists a purchase date, subtotal, and payment status for a synthetic office supply order.
A workflow diagram illustrates boxes and arrows for a fictional library book return process.
An observability note describes a telescope focus adjustment and a star catalog observation.
